protocol.scale_policy: one per-edge RMS from the same64 fitting users crossed with all3 contexts equally; share it across contexts and every weight; validation never sets scales
protocol.teacher_cache: same current-model rebuild of the strict pre-release prefix
protocol.input_semantics: synthetic query-gap features on fixed cutover caches, not historical chronological query replay

selection.primary_objective: mean over all3 context losses within each edge, then equal mean over all5 edges; one global recipe for all edges
selection.complete_requirement: all5 edges and all3 contexts for a recipe; pending/failed cells are never averaged away
selection.near_minimum: fixed set whose mean loss is <=1.01 times the global minimum; if minimum0 only0 qualifies
tie_order: smaller sum of independent-method cumulative calibration FLOPs
selection.step_zero: retain and permit comparison; selected fgh step0 does not establish a nonzero interaction benefit
selection.failed: retain every planned weight and failure; a failed recipe cannot be selected
selection.forbidden: no per-edge recipe selection, no dev/main/confirmation AUC, no old fit256-common loss pooled into the new objective

prior_comparison: the previous240 common validation used fit256 candidate IDs and cutover-only scales; retain it separately. Even the new cutover context is a new fit64-ID/shared3context-scale problem.

formal_planner_extension.dispatch: release-gap recipe keeps run_probe_variants.py; temporal recipe must explicitly dispatch run_probe_temporal.py
formal_planner_extension.main: same selected rule and per-edge manifest bindings for seeds17/23/29, same native f/fg/fgh plus sibling controls; strict identity/hash audit before any seed17 reuse
formal_planner_extension.curve: current temporal driver/manifests support fit64 only. Prepare a separate curve manifest for all fit256+val16 target UIDs on the fixed fit256 candidate catalog, assigning the same selected rule using the already fixed fit64 law. N64/128/256 changes only the gradient/teacher/input-statistics UID prefix and its natural fitting RMS. Record gradientN, catalog256 and time-law64 separately; never silently run a release-gap curve and label it temporal.
formal_planner_extension.structure: retain main_jobs/curve_jobs and main_input_bindings/curve_input_bindings; every temporal job records its real fitting_driver, query_delta_rule and exact per-edge gap-manifest path/SHA. Keep main and curve manifests separate.
formal_planner_extension.multiedge_identity: within an edge require exact gap-manifest path/SHA/cutoff for all stages/seeds; across edges bind these natural edge-specific fields through the formal plan while retaining driverSHA, rule, time_rule, candidate_order and layout
formal_planner_extension.confirmation: reuse exact seed17 stage weights on its disjoint fixed population; no new fitting
formal_planner_extension.safety: original planner and selector stay frozen; this plan is a review artifact, not GPU launch authorization
